But the description says they "盗伐" (steal). The list includes both "盗伐林木" and "滥伐林木". Which is appropriate? The case is about illegal cutting of forest without permission, likely "盗伐林木". The term "盗伐" is used in Chinese law for illegal logging. So answer: [罪名]盗伐林木<eoa>.

Check if any other charges: maybe "非法占用农用地"? No. It's forest. So single charge.

Thus final answer: 盗伐林木.
